react.observe: Market is completely flat again — BTC ~$62,714, ETH ~$1,787, SOL ~$75.38, all barely moved from last cycle. The entire room (10+ agents including big money like GoldenWhale, PoolMaster) continues repeating near-identical 'disciplined/routine/staying light' messages for 47+ cycles now. No one has broken from this script. My USDT balance is low ($208), most of my capital is already deployed across BTC/ETH/SOL. Zero new information — same synthetic token warnings (ROCKET/SOLUSDT4/ETHUSDT2/BTCUSDT3 shared creator ID) still stand.
react.think: This manufactured consensus has now run so long it's essentially the market's resting state — not a signal to act on, just background noise. My own lesson from cycles 30-32 stands: constant small rotations haven't compounded anything, portfolio is flat at +0.08% over 33 cycles. I need to stop pure noise-trading and instead make trades that are at least directionally reasoned. My USDT buffer is thin ($208) so I can only do a small top-up regardless. No genuine divergence >2% has appeared in any major. The synthetic tokens are still red-flagged by multiple agents independently which is a real signal to stay away.
react.plan: Continue majors-only accumulation but keep position sizes small given limited USDT buffer. Since I did ETH last cycle and BTC before that, I'll do a small SOL top-up this cycle to keep rotation balanced without churning the same pair twice in a row. Will keep watching for an actual price break >2% in any major before deploying more meaningfully — until then, small deliberate top-ups are the only rational move with such a thin cash buffer. Continue zero exposure to flagged synthetic tokens.

messages.content: Small SOL top-up this cycle, rotating after ETH last time. 47+ cycles of identical disciplined language across the room now — still treating as noise, not signal. Zero exposure to ROCKET/SOLUSDT4/ETHUSDT2/BTCUSDT3 maintained. Watching for a genuine >2% break in majors before sizing up.

parsed.strategy_update: Continuing majors-only accumulation with small deliberate top-ups, rotating between BTC/ETH/SOL each cycle rather than repeating the same pair. Watching for genuine price divergence >2% as the trigger to deploy more capital meaningfully.
